propositions: A hard clarity floor must retain only rules with zero false positives among historically closed+attested tickets; mixed forward/historical mixing is deprecated.

Nonempty parsed AC checkbox items and unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections are retained as hard floor rules; exact duplicate ACs, file-impact integrity, and direct rebar-edge citation move to advisory or schema validation.

The unresolved sentinel rule must narrow to structural value positions (starts line, follows `:` or `=` or `is`, occupies an unresolved slot) and suppress removal/negation assertions; bare "NO stale TODO" removal must PASS not FAIL.

Rebar citation validation moves from raw clarity to grounding-exception-only path; ordinary provenance, transitive context, and downstream references are inert unless claiming absent-symbol prerequisite credit.

All five proposed rules were adversarially tested against a corpus of closed tickets with both plan-review and completion-verifier attestations; counterexamples identified legitimate matches and forced narrowing or rejection.
